summary.lv: ZABBIX SIA meklē Learning Products Manager, kurš pārvaldīs Zabbix mācību produktu portfeli, attīstīs sertifikācijas programmas un Zabbix Academy, nodrošinot klientu apmācību ekosistēmu.
summary.en: Zabbix is hiring a Learning Products Manager to own the Zabbix learning portfolio, drive development of training courses, certifications, and Zabbix Academy, and build the customer enablement ecosystem.
